fields.name: site
fields.label: Site (optional filter)

options.notes: useEnvData requests /v1/parameter/location?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:34-41); the repeated location_type key is an array, which v1 OptionSource.params (scalar values only) cannot express. Rows are mapped by mapLocationOptions (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36): label = name, value = 'dcim-location:' + JSON [location_type, id] when the row has a location_type, otherwise the bare id. The encoded value is UI-only and is decoded back to id + location_type before use (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:39-59).

client_only_validation: The label says optional, but device options are not fetched until a site is chosen (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:53-56; ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:121-130), so a site is effectively required to pick devices.
Changing site clears device_ids and commands (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:141-145).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. UI-only filter feeding the device option request.

fields.name: device_ids
fields.label: Devices
fields.schema_description: DCIM identifiers of the devices to diagnose.

options.notes: ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:121-130 passes [['site', site], ['managed_only', 'true']]; useDevices strips site and re-appends the decoded site=<id> and site_type=<location_type> (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-51), giving managed_only=true&site=<id>[&site_type=<type>]. No tenant/status filters. Not fetched while site is empty (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:53-56). site is a UI-only form field. Rows map to {key: name, value: id, platform} (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:59-61).

client_only_validation: min(1) 'At least one device is required' (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:86-92). The schema marks the field required but has no minItems.
A single string is coerced to [string] (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:87-91).
The schema's maxItems 1000 (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflow_references.py:24, 83-87) is not enforced client-side.
Choices limited to NVCM-managed devices (managed_only=true) at the selected site.

fields.name: commands
fields.label: Commands
fields.schema_description: Diagnostic command catalog names to run on each device.
fields.widget_today: checkbox group (grouped by platform, with Select all / Deselect all toggle)

options.notes:
The dependency is not the device_ids value but the set of unique `platform` attributes of the selected device option rows (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:132-139). useCommandCatalogGrouped (ui/src/hooks/useCommandCatalogGrouped.ts:44-123) issues one GET ?platform=

per platform (Promise.allSettled; failed requests are dropped), then groups the results into 'Runs on all selected devices' (intersection) plus ' only' groups, each sorted by name. Each checkbox shows name and description. The server already accepts repeated platform params and returns a deduplicated union (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/parameter_v1.py:324-350), which is what the unused useCommandCatalog hook calls (ui/src/hooks/useCommandCatalog.ts:32-53).

client_only_validation: min(1) 'At least one command is required' (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:93). The schema has no minItems.
Commands no longer in the catalog are pruned when the device selection changes (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:147-157).
Placeholder messages when there are no devices, while loading, or when no commands exist (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:244-272).

fields.name: ticketing_platform
fields.label: Ticketing Platform
fields.schema_description: Ticketing platform to update; empty enables ticketless mode.

options.notes: TICKETING_PLATFORMS constant (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:42). The schema is a free string with no enum, so a generic renderer has no source for these choices.

fields.name: issue_key
fields.label: Issue Key (optional — leave blank for ticketless mode)
fields.schema_description: Issue key to update; empty enables ticketless mode.

fields.name: include_tech_support
fields.label: Include tech support bundle
fields.description: Collect and upload a full tech support archive for each device. This significantly increases runtime.
fields.schema_description: Whether to collect a technical-support bundle from each device.

fields.name: user
fields.schema_description: Engineer username or email, populated from request authentication when omitted.
fields.submit_transform: Always "" (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:168). The server fills a falsy user from the authenticated user (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/dynamic_endpoints.py:72-76).

payload_transform: onSubmit (ui/src/app/workflows/diagnosticsworkflow/form/diagnostics-workflow-form.tsx:159-187) builds {device_ids, commands, ticketing_platform, issue_key, include_tech_support, user: ""} in that key order and awaits startWorkflow('/v1/workflow/ngc/diagnostics') (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184), which navigates to /workflows/{id}. Afterwards the form shows a success toast and calls form.reset(). Errors produce a destructive toast. isSubmitting is reset in finally. The site value is dropped. No Playwright test asserts the body.
discrepancies: site is labelled optional but is required in practice, because device options load only after a site is selected.
device_ids and commands require at least one item only in the client. The schema marks both required but allows [].
The schema's maxItems 1000 on device_ids is not enforced client-side.

ticketing_platform: the UI offers only the static value 'jira', while the schema is a free string. An unknown platform makes get_ticketing_provider raise (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/clients/ticketing/registry.py:33-36), and the workflow falls back to ticketless mode with a warning (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/diagnostics.py:401-415).

Setting issue_key with an empty ticketing_platform makes validate_ticket fail, and the workflow silently degrades to ticketless with a warning (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/diagnostics.py:687-701, 401-415). Neither the UI nor the schema requires ticketing_platform when issue_key is set.
user is hardcoded to "", which equals the schema default. The server replaces it with the authenticated user.
The form reads no URL query params, has no Nautobot link, and has no Playwright spec.
contract_gaps: The commands options depend on a derived attribute (the platform of each selected device option row), not on a sibling field value. v1 depends_on {query_param: sibling_field} cannot express derived dependencies or per-value fan-out requests.
Grouped checkbox rendering (shared vs per-platform groups), Select all / Deselect all, and pruning of unavailable selections have no v1 widget or hint.
ticketing_platform needs a static option list on a non-enum string. v1 OptionSource is async-only, and adding an enum would change the schema.
site is a UI-only optional filter that gates device loading. It has no model field, so it cannot carry a UiHint.
issue_key -> ticketing_platform is a one-directional requirement (the platform is needed only when issue_key is set). v1 requires_together is symmetric.
device_reference is described for a string field, so the semantics of an array-of-device picker (device_ids) are undefined.
OptionSource.params is scalar-only (location_type=Site&location_type=Module), and the location value is a UI-encoded composite decoded into site + site_type for /v1/parameter/device.
